narrow: suppression by virus of host type II interferon-mediated signaling pathway

definition: A process in which a symbiont interferes with, inhibits or disrupts a type II interferon-mediated signaling in the host organism. Type II interferon is also known as interferon-gamma.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host type II interferon-mediated signaling pathway
